data.content_ref: inline:Abstraction: SRC_002 and SRC_007 lie at the two extremes of one abstract parameter — the basin measure of stable-matching cuts under monotone majority descent on expanders. SRC_007's expander argument abstracts to 'non-expanding stable cuts are exponentially rare, so consensus whp'; SRC_002 instantiates the same abstract frame at the intermediate point where basin measure is neither exponentially small nor almost-1. The relation is that SRC_002 abstracts away from SRC_007's rarity-of-structures claim to a reachability-of-structures claim: rarity of stable cuts does not imply small basins, since a single stable cut can absorb many initial configurations. It is REFUTED IF basin measure is provably monotone in structural prevalence on random 3-regular graphs — then SRC_002's intermediate constant is impossible and the frame collapses to the two extremes.
